name: Farren's Proof
summary: Along Southshore’s coast, Farren Orinelle sends Alliance recruits to prove his patrol’s work. Marshal Redpath wants evidence that the murlocs are gone from the Western Strand.

sections.title: A Grudging Request
sections.body: After the first coastal sweeps in Down the Coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle faces questions from Marshal Redpath and Southshore’s leaders. Farren says the local murlocs are gone, but his superiors want proof. So he sends wandering Alliance adventurers back to the shore to bring evidence of the kills, leaving the grim work to them.

sections.title: Grisly Evidence
sections.body: West of Southshore, coastal murlocs live along the shallows of the Western Strand. Farren asks you for ten severed murloc heads to satisfy the garrison’s officers. He detests the creatures, whose repulsive sight and smell have spoiled his appetite for Southshore’s chief export and staple food.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is an Alliance officer stationed in Southshore. He wants to report success to his superiors, so he leaves the violent, filthy work of shoreline security to adventurers.

faq.q: Why does Farren need severed murloc heads?
faq.answer: Farren needs severed murloc heads because Marshal Redpath and Southshore’s officials want physical proof before accepting reports that the Western Strand has been cleared.
The murlocs live along the Western Strand, west of Southshore, toward the border of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What happens after turning in Farren's Proof?
faq.answer: After accepting the proof, Farren asks you to report the murloc deaths to Marshal Redpath. Redpath then turns to threats on the Eastern Strand and later passes along Stormwind’s reassignment orders for Farren.

faq.q: Why is Farren disgusted by the murlocs?
faq.answer: Farren finds walking, bipedal fish repulsive. Handling their cold, slimy remains has put him off eating fish and made life in Southshore’s fishing community miserable.
Marshal Redpath commands Southshore’s town defenses. He holds junior officers like Farren Orinelle accountable for regional security.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you help secure Southshore’s coast against native predators. That lets the outpost focus on threats from the Syndicate and the Horde.
As a cook in Southshore, you may find Farren’s aversion to seafood baffling. Fighting along the beach can also yield spare raw catches.
